description: Renovate is here for ONE thing: the mise pins. Dependabot has no mise
ecosystem, and it already covers bun, cargo and Actions (.github/dependabot.yml),
so every other manager is off to avoid two bots opening the same PR.
minimumReleaseAge matches nvim/Makefile's SERVER_COOLDOWN and dependabot.yml's
cooldown: a release must be a week old before a PR proposes it, because the
first days after a release are when a hijacked one is usually caught.
If the host cannot run `mise lock`, the PR bumps mise.toml alone and CI fails
it (tools/gen-mise.sh --check: lock version != pin). Run `make mise-lock` on
the PR branch and push. See docs/decisions/toolchain-policy.md.

packageRules.description: One PR a month for minor and patch bumps; each major arrives alone, as in dependabot.yml.
